title: Beyond Raw IQ: Compact Semantic Representations for Task Oriented Automatic Modulation Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.28813v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic modulation classification (AMC) is an important component of modern wireless communication systems, but conventional signal representations can be expensive to store, process, and communicate, particularly under noisy channel conditions. This work investigates whether learned semantic representations can provide a compact alternative to high-dimensional in-phase and quadrature (IQ) representations while retaining robustness to noise. Starting from a 2048-dimensional IQ representation, we evaluate learned semantic representations with dimensions of 4, 8, 16, 32, and 64. Across the evaluated configurations, a 16-dimensional representation provides the strongest overall trade-off between classification performance, robustness, and representation size. The resulting representation achieves a 128x compression ratio and a 99.22% reduction in dimensionality. We further evaluate representation stability across signal-to-noise ratios

translated_title: 超越原始IQ信号：面向任务的自动调制分类紧凑语义表示
translated_abstract: 自动调制分类（AMC）是现代无线通信系统的重要组成部分，但传统的信号表示在存储、处理和传输方面成本较高，尤其是在噪声信道条件下。本研究探讨了学习到的语义表示能否作为一种紧凑的替代方案，替代高维的同相/正交（IQ）表示，同时保持对噪声的鲁棒性。从2048维的IQ表示出发，我们评估了维度为4、8、16、32和64的学习语义表示。在所评估的配置中，16维表示在分类性能、鲁棒性和表示大小之间提供了最佳的总体权衡。所得的表示实现了128倍的压缩比和99.22%的维度缩减。我们进一步评估了该表示在不同信噪比下的稳定性。
tldr: 该论文提出用学习到的紧凑语义表示替代高维IQ信号表示，其中16维表示即可实现128倍压缩和99.22%的维度缩减，在保持分类性能和噪声鲁棒性的同时大幅降低自动调制分类的存储与传输开销。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that learned compact semantic representations—most effectively at 16 dimensions with 128x compression and 99.22% dimensionality reduction—can replace high-dimensional IQ signal representations for automatic modulation classification while maintaining classification performance and noise robustness.
